blocks.text: Zara Lopez announced that she is permanently “closing the chapter” with Viva Hot Babes, while also revealing an apparent feud between her and Katya Santos and her partner, Paolo Pilar. Lopez issued a statement on her Facebook page on Wednesday, Oct. 28, saying she is no longer a Viva Hot Babe and that she is “never coming back.” “Hindi niyo na kailangang sabihin na hindi ako welcome.
